time_step_rule: dt = 1 ms / m, m the smallest integer with (a) 1.5 * 0.115 m/s * dt <= limit * dx and (b) dt <= 0.7 * sqrt(rho dx^3 / (2 pi gamma)) (capillary_rise_2d.protocol_schedule); (b) binds at every level. Space and time are refined together, so the three levels are the three spatial and the three temporal levels of the contract.
candidate_history: the finest completed level, sampled every 1 ms and linearly interpolated onto the comparison grid

uncertainty_rule.description: Pointwise GCI-type estimate u(t) = F |h_fine(t) - h_medium(t)| / (r^p - 1). With three levels, p is the observed order from the RMS level differences, log(||h_medium - h_coarse|| / ||h_fine - h_medium||) / log(r), clipped to [0.5, 2], with F = 1.25; if the differences do not decrease, p = 1 and F = 3. With two levels only, p = 1 and F = 3 (the comparison is then reported as two-level and does not qualify).

contact_motion_check: The measured wall-contact motion per step (between 1 ms outputs) must stay below the level limit at every output; a violation is reported and disqualifies that level as a temporal level.
failure_policy: A run stopped by the outer fixed-point cap is recorded (case, step, passes) and retried once with SVMP_GENERATED_STATE_OUTER_DYNAMIC_RELAXATION=1 for diagnosis only; the diagnostic run is not a candidate.

run_environment.reason: start from rest with a zero initial rate; the PDE rate solve holds the closed-inlet preload pressure fixed and returns a non-solenoidal impulsive rate at the opened inlet

revisions.change: time-step rule gains the capillary bound (b); the run environment is declared
revisions.evidence: diagnosis jobs 46898188, 46901883, 46907273, 46910758: with m = 2 (10 cells) the outer fixed point reaches its 12-pass cap at step 0; 4-5 passes per step at m = 8 (10 cells) and m = 20 (20 cells); the PDE rate initialization makes the first steps fail at m <= 6 (10 cells) and m <= 14 (20 cells).
